$comment: Known-failing correctness cases: real, reproduced bugs in the tool under test.
They are listed here so `pnpm confirm` can stay a useful gate. A listed
failure does not fail the build; ANY unlisted failure does. Just as
importantly, a listed entry that starts PASSING also fails the build, so a
fixed tool cannot quietly leave a stale suppression behind.
This is not a way to silence inconvenient results. Every entry names the
tool, the observed behaviour, and stays only until the upstream fix lands.
Delete the entry the moment the tool is fixed — the suite will tell you.
Format: { "suite/caseId/tool": "why it fails" }
A value may instead be an object with the reason under "why" plus a scope:
"path": "combined" | "per-case"   which typecheck project produced it.
per-case gives every plant its own 5-file project, the combined --all run
puts all of them in one, and a tool whose analysis degrades at project
scale really does pass one and fail the other.
"platform": "linux" | "win32"     the tools are not identical per OS.
Measured on one commit: verter-tsc leaks ___VERTER___ virtual code into
diagnostics on clean generic SFCs on Linux and is silent on win32, and
vize's LSP lowercases a document path on Linux and loses a cross-file
reference. CI is Linux and is the authority for the published numbers.
Scope only what you have measured on both. A qualified entry is invisible
outside its scope, so it neither excuses a failure nor is reported stale by
a pass that never applied to it; an unqualified one makes whichever run you
did not check call this file wrong.
compile/v-once/vize: vize emits an unquoted object key in the v-once cache path (`data-testid: "once"`), producing JavaScript that does not parse. Siblings outside v-once quote correctly.
compile/custom-directive/vize: vize omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ flag for user directives, so the element never enters dynamicChildren and the directive's updated hook never fires. It does emit 512 for built-in v-show.
compile/dynamic-slot-name/vize: vize emits `{ [_ctx.slotName]: ... }` instead of `[slotName.value]`, so a setup-binding slot name never resolves at runtime.
compile/v-once/verter: verter ignores v-once entirely — no _cache / _setBlockTracking wrapper is emitted and the subtree re-renders.
compile/v-text-v-html/verter: verter silently drops v-text and v-html: emits _createElementVNode("span", _hoisted_1) with an empty props object, no textContent/innerHTML, and reports no error.
compile/custom-directive/verter: verter compiles a <script setup> local directive to _resolveDirective("highlight") instead of binding vHighlight, so it fails to resolve at runtime.
compile/css-v-bind/verter: verter double-prefixes useCssVars keys (emits "--a91785dd-x" where runtime-dom then prepends another "--"), so <style> v-bind() never resolves.
compile/v-show/verter: verter omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ flag for v-show, so toggling the bound value never updates display.
lint/dupe-else-if/verter-lint: rule registered in getLintRuleMetadata() as vue-essential but never fires.
lint/duplicate-attributes/verter-lint: rule registered in getLintRuleMetadata() as vue-essential but never fires.
lint/mutating-props/verter-lint: rule registered in getLintRuleMetadata() as vue-essential but never fires.
lint/template-key/verter-lint: no-template-key registered in getLintRuleMetadata() as vue-essential but never fires on `<template :key>` outside v-for; the planted :key is only reported as no-useless-template-attributes ('Directive ":" on <template> is useless') plus no-lone-template.
lint/invalid-v-model/verter-lint: valid-v-model registered as vue-essential but never fires on `<div v-model="text">` — zero diagnostics. vize and eslint both report it.
lint/invalid-v-slot/verter-lint: valid-v-slot registered as vue-essential but never fires on a v-slot modifier (`<template #header.foo>`); only unrelated no-undef-components/no-bare-strings/multi-word diagnostics are emitted.
lint/invalid-v-slot/vize-lint: valid-v-slot never fires on a v-slot modifier (`#header.foo`) under default, essential, ecosystem, opinionated or happy-path presets.
lint/v-on-native-modifier/vize-lint: no-deprecated-v-on-native-modifier never fires on `@click.native` on a component under any preset. verter and eslint both report it.
lint/reserved-props/vize-lint: no-reserved-props never fires on `defineProps({ key: ... })` under any preset. verter and eslint both report it.
lint/computed-side-effect/vize-lint: no side-effects-in-computed rule ever fires on `count.value += 1` inside computed() under any preset.
lint/computed-side-effect/verter-lint: no-side-effects-in-computed registered as vue-essential but never fires on a real ref mutation inside computed() — zero diagnostics. The same rule DOES fire on the async-computed plant, so it exists but misses actual mutations.
lint/async-computed/vize-lint: no async-in-computed rule ever fires on `computed(async () => { await ... })` under any preset. verter reports no-async-in-computed plus no-side-effects-in-computed; eslint reports 2 issues.
lint/prop-type-constructor/vize-lint: vize detects the planted `type: "String"` as type/require-typed-props (silent on the corrected `type: String` control), but the default text renderer drops the diagnostic block — output is only '1 warning in 1 file' with no [vize:...] tag, so the harness sees 0 attributable issues. --format json/plain both render the diagnostic.
typecheck/inherit-attrs-false-unknown/ve: verter-tsc unconditionally exempts data-* and aria-* prefixed attributes from strictTemplates undeclared-prop checking (aria-zzz is silent, notdeclared errors), so the planted unknown attribute is missed. Unrelated to inheritAttrs.
typecheck/attrs-aria-data-unknown/verter: Same root cause as above — this case isolates the data-*/aria-* prefix exemption directly.
typecheck/generic-component-ok/verter-ts: verter-tsc emits 3 spurious diagnostics about its own virtual code on a CLEAN generic <script setup> component: ___VERTER___Attrs requires 1 type argument, ___VERTER___attributes is not generic, Cannot find name 'items'.
typecheck/component-ref-expose-bad/vize-: vize does not typecheck defineExpose on a component template ref — hide() on a child that only exposes focus is silent. vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar all report TS2339.
typecheck/missing-required-prop/golar-ty: golar typecheck does not report a missing required child prop (<Child /> where title: string is required). vue-tsc, vize and verter-tsc all do.
typecheck/v-if-discriminant-ok/verter-ts: verter-tsc does not auto-unwrap a ref in a tagged-union v-if (pet.kind): it types pet as Ref<Dog | Cat> and reports Property 'kind' does not exist. vue-tsc, vize and golar unwrap correctly and stay clean.
typecheck/v-model-type/verter-tsc: verter-tsc reports the v-model type mismatch at App.vue line 1 instead of the pinned v-model line — the diagnostic exists (TS2322 string vs number) but its location does not survive the template mapping, so the pin gate cannot attribute it.
$comment-platform: Below: verter-tsc and vize do not behave the same on every OS. Each of these was observed on Linux (what CI runs and what the published numbers come from) and NOT on win32 on the same commit, so it is scoped rather than stated unconditionally.

typecheck/generic-default-ok/verter-tsc.why: verter-tsc leaks its own virtual code into a diagnostic on a CLEAN generic SFC: TS2315 Type ___VERTER___attributes is not generic. Silent on win32 with the same package.

typecheck/generic-emit-ok/verter-tsc.why: Same virtual-code leak as generic-default-ok/verter-tsc on a CLEAN generic + defineEmits SFC: TS2314 ___VERTER___Attrs requires 1 type argument.

typecheck/generic-multi-root-ok/verter-t.why: Same virtual-code leak on a CLEAN generic multi-root SFC.

typecheck/generic-slot-ok/verter-tsc.why: Same virtual-code leak on a CLEAN generic + defineSlots SFC.

typecheck/generic-two-params-ok/verter-t.why: Same virtual-code leak on a CLEAN two-param generic SFC: ___VERTER___Attrs requires 2 type arguments.

typecheck/generic-define-model-ok/verter.why: Same virtual-code leak on a CLEAN generic + defineModel SFC.

typecheck/generic-fallthrough-mono-ok/ve.why: Same virtual-code leak, on the generic inheritAttrs plant: it survives the fallthroughAttributes opt-in, so the pair scores fail rather than warn.

typecheck/fallthrough-mono-ok/verter-tsc.why: verter-tsc does not honour vueCompilerOptions.fallthroughAttributes: a native id on a single-root inheritAttrs-default child is TS2353 on the shared tsconfig AND after the opt-in. vue-tsc and golar accept the fallthrough with the opt-in. Passes on win32.

typecheck/fallthrough-vif-both-mono-ok/v.why: Same fallthroughAttributes hole as fallthrough-mono-ok/verter-tsc - v-if/v-else both single-root still errors on the fallthrough id.

typecheck/fallthrough-vif-static-ok/vert.why: Same fallthroughAttributes hole - statically true v-if single root still errors.

typecheck/fallthrough-vif-static-prop-ok.why: Same fallthroughAttributes hole - literal-true prop still errors.

typecheck/fallthrough-native-type-bad/ve.why: verter-tsc reports the fallthrough plant but not the planted type: the diagnostic at the pin names neither disabled nor Booleanish, before or after the opt-in.

$comment-newly-gated: Below: gaps that were failing for months with no entry here. The combined --all run (what CI executes) hid them — it scores every plant inside ONE row and nothing read the per-plant verdicts. Now gated; see run.mjs gateRows.
typecheck/event-mod-click-prevent-dollar: vue-tsc does not expose $event in an inline handler carrying a modifier: @click.prevent="$event.key" reports TS2339 Property '$event' does not exist on ComponentPublicInstance instead of the planted .key-on-PointerEvent error. The diagnostic lands on the right line but is about the wrong thing. vize and verter-tsc both report Property 'key' does not exist on type 'PointerEvent'.
Same $event-with-modifier hole as event-mod-click-prevent-dollar-bad/vue-tsc, byte-identical diagnostic — golar runs the Volar language-core plugin.
typecheck/custom-directive-value-bad/gol: golar does not typecheck a local directive value against DirectiveBinding<number>: a string value is silent (0 diagnostics). vue-tsc, vize and verter-tsc report the mismatch.
typecheck/dynamic-component-prop-bad/viz: vize does not typecheck props through <component :is>: a string passed where the resolved SFC declares count: number produces No type errors found. vue-tsc, golar and verter-tsc report it.

typecheck/attrs-unknown-fallthrough/vert.why: verter-tsc reports nothing for an undeclared id on a component under strictTemplates (0 diagnostics), whatever inheritAttrs says. Reports it correctly on Linux with the same package.

typecheck/inherit-attrs-default-unknown/.why: Same win32-only undeclared-attr hole as attrs-unknown-fallthrough/verter-tsc, with no defineOptions at all.

typecheck/generic-define-model-bad/verte: verter-tsc does not constrain a generic defineModel<T extends string | number>: an object bound with v-model is silent (0 diagnostics). vue-tsc, vize and golar reject it.
typecheck/define-model-modifiers-unknown: verter-tsc reports the unknown modifier as a whole-props TS2322 at App.vue(1,1) — the modelModifiers object literal is quoted in the message, but the location is the file head, not the pinned v-model line, so the pin gate cannot attribute it. Same location-mapping family as v-model-type/verter-tsc.
typecheck/v-if-optional-prop-bad/verter-: verter-tsc reports the planted possibly-undefined access against its generated code at App.vue(1,1) ('__props.label' is possibly undefined) instead of the pinned template line. The finding is right; the location does not survive the mapping.

typecheck/global-component-prop-bad/vize.why: On win32, vize resolves the GlobalComponents augmentation in the 5-file per-case project and reports TS2322 at the pinned line, but reports nothing for the same two files inside the 150-plant combined project — the finding disappears at project scale. Linux reports it in both. Scoped to combined+win32: any wider entry makes one of the three runs wrong.

typecheck/global-component-prop-ok/verte: verter-tsc cannot resolve a globally-registered component on a CLEAN fixture: TS2339 Property 'FancyOk' does not exist on type 'GlobalComponents' plus TS2604. Same GlobalComponents hole as global-component-prop-bad/verter-tsc, here producing two false positives.
typecheck/global-component-prop-bad/vert: verter-tsc cannot resolve the globally-registered component: TS2604 'JSX element type FancyBad does not have any construct or call signatures' masks the planted wrong-prop-type check entirely. vue-tsc and golar report the prop type error.
typecheck/attrs-aria-data-unknown/vize-c: capability gap — vize does not claim strict-component-attrs (undeclared component attrs under strictTemplates), so the planted unknown attribute cannot be reported. Scored as a fail, not a skip.
typecheck/attrs-unknown-fallthrough/vize: capability gap — same missing strict-component-attrs capability as attrs-aria-data-unknown/vize-check.
typecheck/generic-inherit-false-unknown/: capability gap — same missing strict-component-attrs capability as attrs-aria-data-unknown/vize-check.
typecheck/inherit-attrs-default-unknown/: capability gap — same missing strict-component-attrs capability as attrs-aria-data-unknown/vize-check.
typecheck/inherit-attrs-false-unknown/vi: capability gap — same missing strict-component-attrs capability as attrs-aria-data-unknown/vize-check.
typecheck/unknown-prop-strict/vize-check: capability gap — same missing strict-component-attrs capability as attrs-aria-data-unknown/vize-check.
typecheck/fallthrough-mono-false-bad/viz: vize does not reject undeclared attrs under fallthroughAttributes (inheritAttrs:false + single root, id= is silent). Same gap as its missing strict-component-attrs capability, now visible because this family is not skipped.
typecheck/fallthrough-multi-bad/vize-che: vize does not reject undeclared attrs on a multi-root fragment under fallthroughAttributes (id= is silent). vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar all report TS2353.
typecheck/fallthrough-multi-false-bad/vi: vize does not reject undeclared attrs on inheritAttrs:false + multi-root under fallthroughAttributes.
typecheck/fallthrough-native-type-bad/vi: vize does not typecheck fallthrough native attrs: :disabled="'nope'" on a single <button> root is silent. vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar report the string/boolean mismatch.
typecheck/fallthrough-vif-both-mono-fals: vize does not reject undeclared id when inheritAttrs is false and both v-if branches are single-root.
typecheck/fallthrough-vif-static-multi-b: vize does not reject undeclared id when v-if="true" expands to a fragment.
typecheck/fallthrough-vif-mono-multi-bad: vue-tsc (Volar) treats v-if single-root / v-else fragment as fallthrough-eligible and accepts undeclared id. Runtime is not always one root. verter-tsc reports TS2353. A Volar gap, not a plant bug.
golar matches Volar here: v-if mono / v-else multi is treated as a single fallthrough target. verter-tsc reports the extra id.
vize is silent on undeclared id for v-if mono / v-else multi (same missing fallthrough/attr check as its other fallthrough misses).
typecheck/generic-inherit-false-class-ok: Same virtual-code leak as generic-component-ok/verter-tsc on a CLEAN generic + inheritAttrs:false SFC.
typecheck/define-model-modifiers-ok/vize: vize types defineModel as a single Ref, not the [model, modifiers] tuple, so `const [model, modifiers] = defineModel<string, 'trim' | 'capitalize'>()` is TS2488 (Ref is not iterable). vue-tsc and golar accept the tuple and the v-model.trim call site.
typecheck/define-model-modifiers-ok/vert: verter-tsc does not type defineModel modifiers at the call site: v-model.trim on a string model is reported as extra props on the child (TS2322) rather than accepted. vue-tsc and golar stay clean.
typecheck/define-model-modifiers-read-ba: Same defineModel-as-Ref gap as define-model-modifiers-ok/vize-check: the tuple destructure is TS2488, so modifiers.nope is never checked. vue-tsc and golar report TS2339 on nope.

verter-tsc emits a virtual-code leak (Generic type 'Prettify' requires 1 type argument) on defineModel<string, 'trim' | 'capitalize'> and never reports modifiers.nope. vue-tsc and golar report TS2339.
typecheck/define-model-modifiers-unknown: Same defineModel-as-Ref gap: the child tuple is TS2488 and v-model.nope is not reported. vue-tsc and golar report TS2353 on the unknown modifier.
typecheck/define-model-named-modifiers-o: Same defineModel-as-Ref gap on a named model: `const [title, modifiers] = defineModel<string, 'trim'>('title')` is TS2488. vue-tsc and golar stay clean.
Same as define-model-modifiers-ok/verter-tsc — v-model:title.trim is rejected as extra props (TS2322) instead of accepted as a declared modifier.
typecheck/slot-default-implicit-ok/verte: verter-tsc errors on a CLEAN implicit default <slot />: Property '$slots' does not exist on the generated component type. vue-tsc, vize and golar stay clean.
typecheck/slot-unknown-prop-bad/vize-che: vize does not typecheck scoped-slot destructure extras ({ missing } on a { msg: string } payload is silent). vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar report TS2339.
typecheck/slot-v-bind-bad/verter-tsc: verter-tsc does not type <slot v-bind="obj"> as the slot payload: it reports TS2554 Expected 1 arguments, but got 0 instead of the id string/number mismatch. vue-tsc and golar report the payload mismatch.
typecheck/slot-v-bind-ok/verter-tsc: Same <slot v-bind> hole as slot-v-bind-bad/verter-tsc on a CLEAN fixture: TS2554 Expected 1 arguments, but got 0. vue-tsc, vize and golar stay clean.
component-meta/define-model/vize-declara: vize generateDeclaration ignores defineModel entirely — Props and Emits are both emitted as {} for a component whose real API is modelValue/count props plus update:modelValue/update:count events.
component-meta/external-props-import/viz: vize generateDeclaration re-exports the imported type by reference (`export type Props = BaseFieldProps & { value: number };` plus the import) — valid TS, but the declaration-derived meta path cannot enumerate props hidden behind an imported type reference, so name/hint/value go unreported.
component-meta/props-destructure/verter-: @verter/component-meta does not surface destructure initializers as prop defaults — `const { count = 1, verbose = false } = defineProps<...>()` reports both props with an empty default; vue-component-meta reports both defaults.
component-meta/expose/vize-declaration-m: capability gap — vize generateDeclaration does not emit defineExpose members, so the exposed surface (focus/reset/value) cannot be extracted. Scored as a fail, not a skip.
component-meta/define-model-modifiers/vi: Same total defineModel blindness as component-meta/define-model/vize-declaration-meta, now on the modifiers tuple form: for `const [text, textModifiers] = defineModel<string, 'trim'>({ required: true })` plus `defineModel<number>('page', { default: 1 })`, generateDeclaration emits `export type Props = {}; export type Emits = {}; export type Slots = {};` — no modelValue/page prop and no update:modelValue/update:page event. vue-component-meta and @verter/component-meta both report all four members.
component-meta/emits-type-alias/vize-dec: vize generateDeclaration aliases the Emits type BY REFERENCE instead of inlining it: for `defineEmits<FieldEmits>()` it copies the `type FieldEmits = { ... }` declaration through verbatim and then emits `export type Emits = FieldEmits;`. Valid TypeScript, but the declaration-derived meta path has no type resolver, so update:modelValue/blur/commit go unreported. The Props side of the same file IS inlined correctly (`export type Props = { modelValue: string }`), which is why only the events fail. Same reference-not-inlined root cause as component-meta/external-props-import/vize-declaration-meta, on the Emits side and with a LOCAL alias rather than an imported one.
component-meta/interface-extends-props/v: Same reference-not-inlined root cause as component-meta/emits-type-alias and component-meta/external-props-import: for `defineProps<TextFieldProps>()` vize copies both `interface BaseControlProps { ... }` and `interface TextFieldProps extends BaseControlProps { ... }` through verbatim and emits `export type Props = TextFieldProps;`, so none of id/disabled/modelValue/maxLength is enumerable from the declaration. Confirms the gap is a named type REFERENCE of any kind, not specifically a cross-module import.
component-meta/options-api-component/vue: vue-component-meta reports ZERO events for an Options API component that declares the array form `emits: ['increment', 'reset']` — it instead surfaces them as two optional PROPS, `onIncrement` and `onReset`, both typed `((...args: any[]) => any) | undefined`. Reproduced with and without the defineComponent() wrapper. Switching the same component to the object form (`emits: { increment: (value: number) => ..., reset: () => true }`) makes it report both events correctly, so the gap is specific to the array form. @verter/component-meta and vize both report increment/reset from the array form.
component-meta/options-api-component/viz: vize generateDeclaration does not read the Options API `props` option: for `defineComponent({ props: { label: { type: String, required: true }, step: { type: Number, default: 1 } }, ... })` it emits `export type Props = {};`, so label/step go unreported. The emits option on the SAME component is extracted correctly (`export type Emits = { 'increment': any[]; 'reset': any[] };`), so this is a props-side hole in the Options API path rather than the whole path being unimplemented.
compile/v-for-list/fervid: fervid emits double-parenthesised arrow parameters for multi-binding v-for — _renderList(__props.items, ((item, index))=>...) — which is not valid JavaScript, so the module fails to parse. Single-binding v-for (v-for="item in items") is unaffected. The compile surface derives the current invalid-file count on every run instead of freezing a corpus count here.
compile/slot-fallback/fervid: fervid passes slot fallback content to _renderSlot as an ARRAY — _renderSlot(_ctx.$slots, "default", {}, [_createTextVNode("fallback")]) — where Vue's renderSlot requires a thunk (() => [...]). Vue calls the argument, so rendering the fallback throws "fallback is not a function".
compile/dynamic-component-is/fervid: fervid compiles <component :is="..."> as an ordinary user component named "component" (_resolveComponent("component") with is passed as a plain prop) instead of Vue's built-in dynamic element (_resolveDynamicComponent). The bound component never renders.
compile/keep-alive/fervid: Same root cause as compile/dynamic-component-is/fervid: the <component :is> inside <KeepAlive> is compiled as a literal "component" component, so the counter never mounts and no state survives to be kept alive. The _KeepAlive wrapper itself is emitted correctly.
compile/custom-directive/fervid: fervid binds the <script setup> local directive correctly (vHighlight, not _resolveDirective) but omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ patch flag on the element, so it never enters dynamicChildren and the directive's updated hook never fires. Same flag omission as the documented vize and verter cases.
compile/dynamic-slot-name/fervid: fervid emits a dynamic slot as a plain computed key on a static slots object — { [slotName.value]: _withCtx(...) } — instead of _createSlots(..., [{ name, fn }]) with the 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */ flag. The expression itself is correct (slotName.value, not _ctx.slotName), but without the dynamic-slots marker the child is not re-rendered when the slot name changes, so the content stays on the original slot.
compile/event-modifiers/fervid: fervid compiles the KEY modifier @keyup.enter as an EVENT modifier — _withModifiers(handler, ["enter"]) instead of _withKeys(handler, ["enter"]). withModifiers does not recognise "enter", so the guard is a no-op and the handler fires on every keyup rather than only on Enter. .stop and .prevent are compiled correctly.
compile/css-v-bind/fervid: fervid sets __scopeId but emits no useCssVars() call in setup(), so a <style> v-bind(themeColor) never injects its CSS custom property and the bound value is never applied.
compile/define-model-modifiers/verter: verter mis-compiles `const [model, modifiers] = defineModel({ set })`: the options object is emitted into the generated props declaration (props.modelValue.set) instead of being passed to useModel, so the set() transformer never runs — and the destructured modifiers is treated as a ref, so Object.keys(modifiers.value) throws 'Cannot convert undefined or null to object' on first render.
compile/v-bind-object/fervid: fervid silently drops `v-bind="obj"` on an element: only the static props are emitted (no mergeProps, no reference to the bound object at all), so none of the object's attrs or class ever reach the DOM. The 16 /* FULL_PROPS */ flag is still emitted.
compile/dynamic-arg/vize: vize compiles dynamic argument names to `_ctx.attrName` / `_toHandlerKey(_ctx.evtName)` instead of the setup bindings (attrName.value), but inline script-setup bindings are closure-local and not on the proxy, so the key resolves from undefined — the attribute is never set and the handler never binds. Same _ctx.* root cause as compile/dynamic-slot-name/vize.
compile/dynamic-arg/fervid: fervid emits a dynamic v-on argument as a raw prop key — `[evtName.value]: $event => ...` with no toHandlerKey — so the key is 'click' instead of 'onClick' and it is applied as a plain attribute, never bound as a listener. The element also gets no FULL_PROPS flag, so a later event-name change would not repatch either.
compile/dynamic-arg/verter: verter emits the dynamic v-on argument as the LITERAL prop name 'on[evtName]' (a static string key, also hoisted into the dynamicProps array), so the expression is never evaluated and no listener is ever attached.
compile/v-for-template-destructure/fervi: Same double-parenthesised arrow root cause as compile/v-for-list/fervid, now with a destructured alias: _renderList(rows.value, (({ id, label }, i))=>...) is invalid JavaScript ('Invalid destructuring assignment target'), so the module fails to parse.
compile/v-for-template-destructure/verte: verter drops `:key="id"` on <template v-for> — each item is emitted as _createElementBlock(_Fragment, null, [...], 64) with no key — so the list diffs unkeyed and rows are patched in place instead of moved (DOM node identity does not follow the key).
compile/v-model-choice/verter: verter omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ flag on v-model elements (the reference emits it on all five), so the model directives' beforeUpdate never runs and el._modelValue goes stale — the second checkbox toggle computes from the mount-time array and writes [] instead of ['a']. Same flag-omission family as compile/v-show/verter and compile/custom-directive/verter.
compile/v-show/fervid: fervid emits the v-show directive binding correctly (_withDirectives with _vShow) but omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ patch flag, so toggling the bound value never updates display. Same root cause as compile/custom-directive/fervid and the documented verter case.
lsp/diagnostics-template/vize: vize does not publish a type error for an undeclared extra component attribute (`planted-bad-prop` / plantedBadProp). `vize check` on the same fixture is silent; vue-tsc reports TS2353. Volar and Verter LSP both name the extra prop. When the plant was camelCase, LSP only published vue/attribute-hyphenation (message does not name the attr).
lsp/document-symbol-structure/vize: vize documentSymbol returns only the SFC block outline (template, script setup) with no children — script bindings (greeting) and template elements are absent from the outline. Volar and Verter both return a 6-symbol tree naming greeting. Observed with Corsa unreachable on Windows, but documentSymbol is syntactic and vize's other non-type answers (completion, prop-attr definition) work in the same session.
lsp/references-prop-template/verter: verter references from a prop declaration never cross the file boundary: at Child.vue's `title: string` it returns only the declaration and Child.vue's own {{ title }}, missing App.vue's :title="greeting" template usage even though App.vue is open. Volar returns all three sites.
lsp/rename-prop-template/verter: Same cross-file hole as references-prop-template/verter, as a broken refactor: rename of the `title` prop edits Child.vue only (declaration + template), leaving App.vue's :title="greeting" bound to a prop that no longer exists. Volar edits App.vue's template too.
lsp/references-prop-template/vize: vize references from a prop declaration return only child.vue and miss App.vue's :title="greeting" usage. The document path comes back lower-cased (child.vue), which is also why the miss surfaces on a case-sensitive filesystem; on win32 the case cannot be observed at all because vize LSP skips with 'type checking unavailable (Corsa not reachable)'. Volar returns all three sites.
lsp/rename-prop-template/vize: Same cross-file hole as references-prop-template/vize, as a broken refactor: rename of the `title` prop edits child.vue only, leaving App.vue's :title="greeting" bound to a prop that no longer exists. Volar edits App.vue too.
format/format-pug-template/vize-fmt: vize fmt re-indents a <template lang="pug"> block by a uniform +2 spaces. Pug is indentation-significant and rejects a document whose first line is indented (pug 3: unexpected token "indent" at 2:1), so the formatted SFC no longer compiles under the vue-loader/plugin-vue pug pipeline. prettier, oxfmt and biome pass the block through untouched.
format/format-top-level-comments/vize-fm: vize fmt drops SFC top-level comments between blocks and after the last block (208B -> 134B; only the comment before the first block survives). prettier, oxfmt and biome preserve all three.
lsp/diagnostics-clear-after-fix/vize: Same extra-prop hole as diagnostics-template/vize — the planted attr never appears as a type diagnostic, so clear-after-fix cannot be confirmed.
